s3683: A technical inspection (check) of machines is:
s3679: The process of examining a machine's technical condition without dismantling its assemblies, on the basis of which a conclusion is drawn about the machine's actual technical condition
s3680: Checking a machine during a test run after its maintenance
s3681: Determining the condition of the machine's main assemblies from external data
s3682: The process of examining a machine's technical condition without dismantling its assemblies, on the basis of which a conclusion is drawn about writing the machine off
s3684: A technical inspection (check) of machines is the process of examining a machine's technical condition without dismantling its assemblies, on the basis of which a conclusion is drawn about the machine's actual technical condition.
s3688: Under the Code of Administrative Offences of Georgia, failure of the driver and/or passenger to wear a fastened motorcycle helmet while riding a motorcycle results in:
s3686: A fine of GEL 100 and suspension of the right to drive a motorcycle for 3 months
s3689: According to Article 118³ of the Code of Administrative Offences of Georgia, failure of the driver and/or passenger to wear a fastened motorcycle helmet while riding a motorcycle results in a fine of GEL 100.
s3693: Under the Code of Administrative Offences of Georgia, transporting construction or other materials or waste in vehicles with a faulty cargo body or trailer coupling, creating a risk of littering or damaging the road surface, results in:
s3691: A fine of GEL 300 and suspension of the right to drive the vehicle for 3 months
s3694: According to Article 119¹ of the Code of Administrative Offences of Georgia, transporting construction or other materials or waste in vehicles with a faulty cargo body or trailer coupling, creating a risk of littering or damaging the road surface, results in a fine of GEL 300.
s3698: Under the Code of Administrative Offences of Georgia, exceeding the set speed limit by more than 15 km/h by the driver of a vehicle that provides local urban, intercity, or international regular passenger transport established by international treaties and agreements of Georgia, results in:
s3697: A fine of GEL 200 or suspension of the right to drive for 3 months
s3699: According to Part 2 of Article 125 of the Code of Administrative Offences of Georgia, committing the offence under Part 1 of this Article (the driver of a vehicle exceeding the set speed limit by more than 15 km/h) by a person who provides local urban, intercity, or international regular passenger transport established by international treaties and agreements of Georgia, results in a fine of GEL 200.
s3703: Under the Code of Administrative Offences of Georgia, carrying out international road transport of goods or passengers in breach of the rules of the European Agreement concerning the Work of Crews of Vehicles engaged in International Road Transport (AETR) results in:
s3701: Suspension of the right to drive for 1 year
s3704: According to Part 7 of Article 127¹ of the Code of Administrative Offences of Georgia, carrying out international road transport of goods or passengers in breach of the rules of the European Agreement concerning the Work of Crews of Vehicles engaged in International Road Transport (AETR) results in a fine of GEL 500.
s3708: Which of the following faults prohibits the driver from driving the vehicle?
s3705: Only when the steering mechanism is faulty
s3706: Only when the horn is faulty
s3707: Only when the fog lights are faulty
s3709: According to paragraph 13 of Article 21 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, the driver is prohibited from driving if the service brake system, the steering mechanism or the coupling device of a vehicle combination is faulty, and also at night if the dipped-beam and main-beam headlights have both failed (gone out) at the same time (or are missing) and/or the rear position lights have failed, on a road without street lighting or with insufficient visibility. If the windscreen wiper on the driver's side does not work, driving a motor vehicle in fog, rain or snow is prohibited.
s3713: In fog, rain or snow, driving a motor vehicle is prohibited:
s3710: If the windscreen wiper on the driver's side does not work
s3711: If there is no warning triangle
s3712: If there are no fog lights
s3717: At night, if the dipped-beam and main-beam headlights of a motor vehicle both fail (go out) at the same time, the driver is prohibited from:
s3714: Driving on a road without street lighting
s3715: Driving on any road, whether or not it has street lighting
s3716: Driving on a two-way road with street lighting
s3721: Further movement of the vehicle is prohibited:
s3718: If the service brake system is faulty
s3719: If the fuel supply system is not leak-tight
s3720: If the exhaust silencer is faulty
s3722: According to paragraph 13 of Article 21 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, the driver is prohibited from driving if the service brake system, the steering mechanism or the coupling device of a vehicle combination is faulty, and also at night if the dipped-beam and main-beam headlights have both failed (gone out) at the same time (or are missing) and/or the rear position lights have failed, on a road without street lighting or with insufficient visibility. If the windscreen wiper on the driver's side does not work, driving a motor vehicle in fog, rain or snow is prohibited.
s3726: The driver must check and ensure the technical soundness of the vehicle:
s3723: Before setting off and during the journey
s3727: According to paragraph 12 of Article 21 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, the driver must check the technical soundness of the vehicle before setting off and ensure it during the journey.
s3731: Further movement of the vehicle is prohibited if:
s3728: The coupling device of the vehicle combination is faulty
s3729: The anti-theft device does not work
s3736: The driver is prohibited from continuing to drive the vehicle if:
s3732: At night, the dipped-beam and main-beam headlights (or the vehicle has none) and/or the rear position lights have all gone out at the same time, on a road without street lighting or with insufficient visibility
s3733: The fuel supply system is not leak-tight
s3734: The windscreen wipers do not work in the set mode
s3737: The windscreen wiper on the driver's side does not work in fog, rain or snow
s3738: A rear-view mirror provided for by the vehicle's design is missing
s3740: The seat belts are not in working order
s3744: Under the technical requirements for motor vehicles, which of these is not allowed?
s3741: Both a missing or loose wheel bolt or nut (even just one) and cracks in the wheel rims
s3742: Only cracks in the wheel rims
s3743: Only a missing or loose wheel bolt or nut (even just one)
s3745: According to paragraphs 6 and 7 of Article 8 of the Technical Regulation "On the technical requirements for motor vehicles, compliance with which is checked by roadworthiness testing, and the methods for carrying out such testing", approved by Resolution No. 30 of the Government of Georgia of 3 January 2014: 6. A missing or loose wheel bolt or nut, even just one, is not allowed. 7. Cracks in the wheel rims are not allowed.
s3749: Under the technical requirements for motor vehicles, the tread depth of passenger car tyres must be at least:
s3750: According to subparagraph "a" of paragraph 1 of Article 1 of the Technical Regulation "On the technical requirements for motor vehicles, compliance with which is checked by roadworthiness testing, and the methods for carrying out such testing", approved by Resolution No. 30 of the Government of Georgia of 3 January 2014, the tyre tread depth must be at least: a) for passenger cars – 1.6 mm.
s3751: Is it prohibited to operate a vehicle if a tyre does not match the vehicle model in size or permitted load?
s3752: It is prohibited to operate a vehicle if a tyre does not match the vehicle model in size or permitted load.
s3755: Unless the manufacturer's operating documentation states otherwise, the total free play in the steering system of a passenger car must not exceed:
s3756: According to subparagraph "a" of paragraph 3 of Article 5 of the Technical Regulation "On the technical requirements for motor vehicles, compliance with which is checked by roadworthiness testing, and the methods for carrying out such testing", approved by Resolution No. 30 of the Government of Georgia of 3 January 2014, the total free play in the steering system must not exceed the limit given in the manufacturer's operating documentation, and if no such values are given, the following limits: a) for passenger cars, and for trucks and buses built on their base – 10°.
s3757: Which drawing shows the correct position of the hands on the steering wheel?
s3758: The correct position of the hands on the steering wheel is one where, if an emergency arises, the driver can turn the wheel quickly and easily in any direction and return it to its starting position. The correct position also keeps the load on the hands to a minimum and reduces fatigue. The driver is always ready to react to changes in the traffic situation. The correct position of the hands on the steering wheel is shown in the second drawing.
s3762: Under the technical requirements for motor vehicles, which of the following brake system faults are not allowed?
s3759: Any of the faults listed in this question
s3760: Only unsatisfactory operation or leaking of the control valve of the hand-operated brake, or damage, deformation or excessive wear of its control
s3761: Only a faulty handbrake ratchet mechanism or excessive lever travel
s3763: According to paragraphs 15 and 16 of Article 4 of the Technical Regulation "On the technical requirements for motor vehicles, compliance with which is checked by roadworthiness testing, and the methods for carrying out such testing", approved by Resolution No. 30 of the Government of Georgia of 3 January 2014: 15. Unsatisfactory operation or leaking of the control valve of the hand-operated brake, or damage, deformation or excessive wear of its control, is not allowed. 16. A faulty handbrake ratchet mechanism or excessive lever travel is not allowed.
s3764: Only faulty pressure gauges of the pneumatic or pneumohydraulic brake drive
s3765: Only fluid leaking from the hydraulic brake
s3766: According to paragraphs 9 and 17 of Article 4 of the Technical Regulation "On the technical requirements for motor vehicles, compliance with which is checked by roadworthiness testing, and the methods for carrying out such testing", approved by Resolution No. 30 of the Government of Georgia of 3 January 2014: 9. The warning and monitoring system of the brake systems, the pressure gauges of the pneumatic and pneumohydraulic brake drive, and the locking device of the parking brake control must be in working order. 17. Damage to brake valves (pressure-reducing valves and regulators), excessive air leakage, excessive oil leakage from the compressor, unreliable mounting, and fluid leaking from the hydraulic brake are not allowed.
s3767: Is it prohibited to operate a vehicle if the number, type and operating mode of its external lighting devices do not meet the requirements of the vehicle's design?
s3768: According to paragraph 3 of Article 7 of the Technical Regulation "On the technical requirements for motor vehicles, compliance with which is checked by roadworthiness testing, and the methods for carrying out such testing", approved by Resolution No. 30 of the Government of Georgia of 3 January 2014, motor vehicles that are no longer in production may be fitted with external lighting devices from motor vehicles of other makes and models. The number, type, placement and operating mode of the external lighting devices must meet the requirements set for the design of the motor vehicle.
s3770: Is it allowed to fit tyres with different tread patterns on the same axle?
s3769: It is allowed only on passenger cars
s3771: According to paragraph 5 of Article 8 of the Technical Regulation "On the technical requirements for motor vehicles, compliance with which is checked by roadworthiness testing, and the methods for carrying out such testing", approved by Resolution No. 30 of the Government of Georgia of 3 January 2014, a motor vehicle must be fitted with tyres that, in any driving mode, rule out contact between the tyres and the suspension or any other part of the vehicle. Fitting tyres with different tread patterns on the same axle is not allowed.
s3775: In which of the following cases is it prohibited to operate a vehicle?
s3772: Only if exhaust gases leak at the joints of the exhaust system
s3773: Only if gas cylinders are used whose periodic inspection is overdue
s3774: Only if fuel leaks from the fuel system of a petrol or diesel engine
s3776: According to paragraphs 18 and 21 of Article 9 of the Technical Regulation "On the technical requirements for motor vehicles, compliance with which is checked by roadworthiness testing, and the methods for carrying out such testing", approved by Resolution No. 30 of the Government of Georgia of 3 January 2014: 18. Fuel leaks in the fuel system of petrol and diesel engines are not allowed. 21. The fuel system of gas-cylinder motor vehicles must be leak-tight. Using cylinders whose periodic inspection is overdue on a gas-cylinder motor vehicle is not allowed. According to paragraph 3 of Article 14 of the same Regulation, leaks at the joints of the exhaust system are not allowed, and on motor vehicles fitted with catalytic converters, releasing exhaust gases into the atmosphere by bypassing the catalytic converters is not allowed.
s3780: Under the technical requirements for motor vehicles, in which of the following cases is it prohibited to operate a vehicle?
s3777: If any of the faults listed in this question is present
s3778: Only if the horn does not work
s3779: Only if a rear-view mirror provided for by the vehicle's design is missing
s3781: According to paragraph 1 of Article 10 of the Technical Regulation "On the technical requirements for motor vehicles, compliance with which is checked by roadworthiness testing, and the methods for carrying out such testing", approved by Resolution No. 30 of the Government of Georgia of 3 January 2014, a motor vehicle's horn must be in working order. According to subparagraph "g" of paragraph 1 of Article 13 of the same Regulation, a motor vehicle must be equipped with the following items: g) rear-view mirrors.
s3782: Is it allowed to have cracks or spots on the windscreen on the driver's side, within the area swept by the wiper?
s3783: According to paragraph 4 of Article 6 of the Technical Regulation "On the technical requirements for motor vehicles, compliance with which is checked by roadworthiness testing, and the methods for carrying out such testing", approved by Resolution No. 30 of the Government of Georgia of 3 January 2014, a transparent tinted film may be attached to the top of the windscreen, no wider than 140 mm, and on motor vehicles of the relevant categories, no wider than the distance between the top edge of the windscreen and the upper limit of the area cleaned by its wiper. Cracks or spots on the windscreen on the driver's side, within the area swept by the wiper, are not allowed.
s3786: If a vehicle is fitted with head restraints, they must be adjusted so that the head of the driver and passengers rests on them:
s3784: At the back of the head
s3787: If a vehicle is fitted with head restraints, they must be adjusted so that the head rests on them at the back of the head.
s3788: Both a working parking brake provided by its design and chocks to stop it rolling away
s3789: Only chocks to stop it rolling away
s3790: Only a working parking brake provided by its design
s3792: According to paragraph 3 of Article 22 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, an animal-drawn vehicle must have a working parking brake provided by its design and chocks to stop it rolling away, and must also be fitted with lights in the manner established by this Law.
s3795: May a group of pedestrians marching in a column move on the carriageway?
s3793: It is allowed, but only in the direction of traffic, on the right-hand side, no more than four people abreast
s3794: It is allowed, but only against the direction of traffic, on the right-hand side, no more than two people abreast
s3796: According to subparagraph "b" of paragraph 2 of Article 24 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, if there is a footpath, sidewalk or roadside suitable for pedestrians along the edge of the carriageway, pedestrians must use it, while taking the necessary precautions. Groups of pedestrians moving in an organised way or marching in a column may walk on the carriageway; however, they may move on the carriageway only in the direction of traffic, on the right-hand side, no more than four people abreast. The group must be accompanied in front and behind, on the left side, by escorts carrying red flags, and at night or in insufficient visibility, carrying lit lamps (white at the front, red at the rear).
s3800: When crossing the carriageway, may a pedestrian step out from in front of a stopped vehicle?
s3797: Yes, after making sure that no vehicles are approaching
s3799: Yes, but only on one-way roads
s3801: According to paragraph 9 of Article 24 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, when crossing the carriageway, a pedestrian must not step out from in front of a stopped vehicle or another obstacle that limits visibility until they have made sure that no vehicles are approaching.
s3805: Outside built-up areas, on a two-way road with no dividing strip and no sidewalk, a person pushing a motorcycle must use:
s3802: The right-hand side of the carriageway
s3803: The left-hand side of the carriageway
s3806: According to paragraph 5 of Article 24 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, outside built-up areas, on a two-way road with no dividing strip and no sidewalk, a pedestrian must use the shoulder on the side facing oncoming traffic, and if there is none or it cannot be used, the left-hand side of the carriageway, walking against the direction of traffic (except where, in the situation, walking on the right-hand side of the carriageway in the direction of traffic is safer). However, a person pushing a bicycle, moped or motorcycle, and a person with a disability using a wheelchair, must use the right-hand side of the carriageway.
s3810: Is it prohibited to drive on a road a vehicle whose actual mass exceeds 44 tonnes?
s3807: It is not prohibited if it is an overweight (heavy) vehicle travelling on the road after agreement with the competent authority (agency) in the manner established by law, in line with the terms of that agreement
s3808: It is prohibited in all cases
s3809: It is not prohibited only on secondary roads
s3811: According to subparagraph "a" of paragraph 3 of Article 47 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, a vehicle may not travel on a road if: a) the maximum load on any drive or non-drive axle exceeds 10 tonnes (except a motor vehicle with a single drive axle, whose maximum load on the drive axle must not exceed 11.5 tonnes) and/or its actual mass exceeds 44 tonnes and/or its actual mass exceeds its maximum permitted mass. According to subparagraph "a" of paragraph 5 of the same Article, apart from the ban on the actual mass exceeding the maximum permitted mass, paragraph 3 of this Article does not apply to: a) an oversized (large) or overweight (heavy) vehicle that travels on the road after agreement with the competent authority (agency) in the manner established by the legislation of Georgia, in line with the terms of that agreement.
s3816: The maximum axle load of a motor vehicle with a single drive axle (other than an overweight vehicle) must not exceed:
s3817: According to subparagraph "a" of paragraph 3 of Article 47 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, a vehicle may not travel on a road if: a) the maximum load on any drive or non-drive axle exceeds 10 tonnes (except a motor vehicle with a single drive axle, whose maximum load on the drive axle must not exceed 11.5 tonnes) and/or its actual mass exceeds 44 tonnes and/or its actual mass exceeds its maximum permitted mass.
s3820: To protect road safety, it is prohibited to drive a motor vehicle whose windows are tinted:
s3818: In breach of the rules set by the Minister of Internal Affairs of Georgia
s3819: In breach of the rules set by local self-government bodies
s3821: According to subparagraph "b" of paragraph 1 of Article 12 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, to protect road safety, it is prohibited to drive a motor vehicle whose windows are tinted, or whose light transmission is otherwise restricted, in breach of the rules set by the Minister of Internal Affairs of Georgia.
s3825: In the manner established by the legislation of Georgia, a road user has the right:
s3822: Both to move freely and without hindrance on roads and to appeal against the actions of an official authorised in the field of road safety
s3823: Only to appeal against the actions of an official authorised in the field of road safety
s3824: Only to move freely and without hindrance on the road
s3826: According to subparagraphs "a" and "c" of paragraph 1 of Article 20 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, a road user has the right, in the manner established by the legislation of Georgia: a) to move freely and without hindrance on the road; c) to appeal against the actions of an official authorised in the field of road safety.
s3830: A driver is prohibited from driving a motor vehicle:
s3827: Both when the relevant right to drive has been suspended and when it has been revoked or terminated (cancelled)
s3828: Only when the relevant right to drive has been suspended
s3829: Only when the relevant right to drive has been revoked or terminated (cancelled)
s3831: According to paragraph 3 of Article 21 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, a driver must have the knowledge and skills needed to drive a vehicle. If driving a vehicle is allowed only after the relevant right to drive has been granted in the manner set by the legislation of Georgia, the driver is prohibited from driving a vehicle of that category or subcategory without obtaining the relevant right to drive, and also when that right has been suspended, revoked or terminated (cancelled).
s3832: Must a driver undergo a test for intoxication at the request of an authorised person of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Georgia if there are sufficient grounds to believe that the driver is under the influence of alcohol, drugs or psychotropic substances?
s3833: According to paragraph 16 of Article 21 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, if there are sufficient grounds to believe that the driver is under the influence of alcohol, drugs or psychotropic substances, the driver must, at the request of an authorised person of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Georgia, undergo a test for intoxication in the manner established by the legislation of Georgia.
s3838: A driver involved in a road traffic accident must:
s3834: Do everything listed in this question
s3835: Only avoid changing anything at the scene or destroying traces that may help establish liability
s3836: Only write down the surnames of eyewitnesses
s3837: Only take the necessary measures to ensure traffic safety at the scene of the accident
s3839: According to subparagraph "d" of paragraph 1 of Article 27 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, a driver involved in a road traffic accident must take measures to ensure traffic safety at the scene of the accident, avoid changing anything at the scene or destroying traces that may help establish liability, and write down the surnames of eyewitnesses.
s3841: Is a trackless vehicle prohibited from driving onto the tram tracks for the opposite direction?
s3840: It is not prohibited if all the lanes for traffic in the same direction are occupied
s3842: According to paragraph 15 of Article 31 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, subject to the requirements of paragraph 6 of Article 32 of this Law, it is permitted to drive on tram tracks for the same direction that are on the left, level with the carriageway, if all the lanes intended for traffic in the same direction are occupied, and also when going around an obstacle, overtaking, turning left or making a U-turn. The tram must not be obstructed. Driving onto tram tracks for the opposite direction is prohibited.
s3846: May a driver use a mobile phone while driving a vehicle?
s3843: It is allowed if the driver uses the phone's loudspeaker function and has both hands free to drive the vehicle
s3844: It is not allowed under any circumstances
s3845: It is allowed if the driver has one hand free to drive the vehicle
s3847: According to paragraph 8 of Article 21 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, while the vehicle is moving the driver must avoid any action not related to driving. The driver is prohibited from using a mobile phone while driving a vehicle. This ban does not apply when the driver uses a mobile phone headset or the phone's loudspeaker (or remote) talk function and has both hands free to drive the vehicle.
s3850: If animals that were on the road unattended, or in breach of the rules for grazing or driving livestock, are killed or injured in a road traffic accident:
s3848: The driver is released from the obligation to compensate for the damage caused by their death or injury
s3849: The driver must compensate for the damage caused by their death or injury
s3851: According to paragraph 9 of Article 22 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, if animals that were on the road unattended, or in breach of the rules for grazing or driving livestock, are killed or injured in a road traffic accident, the driver is released from the obligation to compensate for the damage caused by their death or injury.
s3856: Wearing a seat belt while driving a motor vehicle is mandatory:
s3853: Only when driving on a gravel road
s3854: Only when driving on a dirt road
s3855: Only when driving on a cement-concrete road
s3857: According to paragraph 9 of Article 21 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, when driving a motor vehicle (other than a vehicle whose design does not include seat belts), the driver must wear a seat belt in the established manner and must make sure that the passenger sitting to their right (or left) wears a seat belt.
s3861: When operational search and investigative activities are being carried out, the driver of a vehicle must, on request, present to an authorised person of the Ministry of Internal Affairs for inspection:
s3859: A medical certificate confirming their health
s3862: According to subparagraph "b" of paragraph 1 and paragraph 2 of Article 13 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic: 1. Vehicle traffic on a road is restricted or temporarily stopped: b) to carry out certain operational search and investigative activities; 2. In the cases provided for in subparagraphs "b" and "c" of paragraph 1 of this Article, the driver of a vehicle must, on request, present only an identity document for inspection to an authorised person of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Georgia.
